name: cloudflare-openai-agents-api-executor
description: OpenAI Agents API executor on Cloudflare Workers and Durable Object Containers.

OPENAI_EXECUTOR_API_KEY.description: Restricted OpenAI project key passed only to the Codex executor. Grant List models read access and disable other permissions where possible.

EXECUTOR_CLIENT_SECRET.description: Bearer token that protects manual executor cleanup requests. Generate one with `openssl rand -hex 32`.

EXECUTOR_KEEP_ALIVE_SECONDS.description: Seconds before the executor lifecycle deadline expires (default: 30). Lifecycle events and active session checks re-arm the deadline.

EXECUTOR_PREWARM_ENABLED.description: Start self-hosted executor Containers when agent.session.created arrives (default: true).

EXECUTOR_SNAPSHOTS_ENABLED.description: Snapshot the whole Container when a session is confirmed idle and restore it on the next start (default: true).

OPENAI_API_KEY.description: OpenAI controller key used to retrieve session state for webhook-driven provisioning. Configure this together with OPENAI_AGENT_ID and OPENAI_WEBHOOK_SECRET.

OPENAI_AGENT_ID.description: OpenAI agent ID served by the webhook. Sessions for other agents are ignored.

OPENAI_WEBHOOK_SECRET.description: Signing secret for the required OpenAI webhook. Configure this together with OPENAI_API_KEY and OPENAI_AGENT_ID after registering the deployed /webhook URL.

scripts.test: npm run test:workers && npm run test:node
